title: Bird's-eye view of the birthplace of Confucius, 1998 postal card
alt: Aerial photograph of a long walled compound of orange-roofed halls surrounded by low grey city blocks.

catalog.label: Subject
catalog.value: A Bird's Eye View of the Birthplace of Confucius / 孔子故里鸟瞰 (as printed)

catalog.label: Location
catalog.basis: Confucius's birthplace is Qufu; the card names the birthplace, not the city

catalog.label: Format
catalog.value: China Post pre-stamped special postal card, TP8, card 4 of 4, 1998 B

catalog.label: Stamps
catalog.value: Imprinted 420 fen stamp repeating the aerial view, plus an added China 80 fen pug stamp

tpa_note: A 1998 postal card, still valid, mailed 28 years after it was printed.
